data.one_liner: Widget that auto‑scrolls its child infinitely in a loop
data.what_it_does: ScrollLoopAutoScroll automatically scrolls a custom child widget in a continuous loop. It supports user scroll input, custom direction, durations, gaps, and reverse scrolling.
use_when: Need an infinite scrolling banner or carousel
Want to allow user interaction while auto‑scrolling
Need a simple, single‑purpose widget without external dependencies
avoid_when: Performance‑critical or large lists where custom scrolling logic is required
Complex layouts that need fine‑grained scroll control
strengths: Supports user scroll input and reverse scrolling
weaknesses: No unit tests or CI reported
No support for advanced scroll behaviors
data.minimal_example:
ScrollLoopAutoScroll(
  child: Text(
    'Very long text that bleeds out of the rendering space',
    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20),
  ),
  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
)
